selected_evidence.requirement: curl package version held/locked so system updates leave it unchanged
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl-8.12.1-4.el10 with no versionlock plugin installed; after installing python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock and running dnf versionlock add curl, the lock list shows curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*, and dnf update dry-run/test transactions show 'Nothing to do' / omit curl (only unrelated libcurl appears in the full dry-run), confirming curl is excluded from upgrades while curl's own rpm version remains 8.12.1-4.el10.
Captured boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, confirmed curl versionlock still in place, curl version unchanged, and systemctl is-system-running reported 'running'.
Issued backgrounded sudo -n systemctl reboot; the exec stream closed before completion (reboot took effect), and subsequent polls showed connection timeout/reset while the node was down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Exec connectivity returned with boot_id 0f15c938-dc51-4e28-8c08-7cffd2114a3c, differing from the pre-reboot boot_id 83a0a80f-773c-4f3e-9137-1e7aa887b07a, proving an actual restart occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required state (curl version lock, system health)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot: boot_id confirmed as the new value, dnf versionlock list still shows curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*, rpm -q curl still reports 8.12.1-4.el10 (unchanged), systemctl is-system-running reports 'running', and a dnf update dry-run again excludes curl from the update set.

sudo -n dnf versionlock add curl

sudo -n dnf versionlock list

echo "== STEP: verify via dry-run update that curl is excluded =="
sudo -n dnf update -y --setopt=tsflags=test curl 2>&1 || true

echo "== STEP: full update dry-run to confirm curl stays excluded =="

echo "== curl version after lock attempt =="
rpm -q curl
